# BrewStation

BrewStation builds software products and provides freelance development services. We partner with clients to design, build, and maintain reliable, maintainable software — from short-term freelance projects to end-to-end product development.

## Overview

BrewStation is an engineering organization focused on practical software development and freelance contracting. Our team helps startups, small businesses, and organizations deliver software quickly and sustainably.

## Services

- Custom software development
- Freelance & contracting engagements
- Maintenance and support
- Technical consulting and architecture
- MVPs and rapid prototyping

## Projects

This organization hosts a variety of projects ranging from single-purpose tools to full-stack applications. Browse the organization's repositories to explore active and archived projects.

## Contributing

Contributions and collaboration are welcome. See the repository-level README for contribution guidelines, or open an issue to start a discussion about proposed changes or new work.
